svg.title: Source-traced dense illustrated panel
svg.desc: Source-traced contour study. Each compound ink path is editable as a group; small source details are preserved as contours without assigning anatomy or provenance. Vectorized from a cropped, thresholded view of G3-015; full-resolution original is linked beside the SVG. This is a visual source-trace, not an independently verified historical reconstruction. Source G3-015.
svg.metadata: Source G3-015. contemporary study; editable named groups; no embedded raster.
